data.one_liner: Keyboard visibility tracking and automatic dismissal without native plugins
data.what_it_does: Allows checking if the on-screen keyboard is visible and explicitly dismissing it. Provides a wrapper widget to automatically dismiss the keyboard when tapping outside of a text field.
use_when: You want to automatically dismiss the on-screen keyboard when tapping outside of text fields
You need to programmatically check if the keyboard is visible
You want a pure Flutter solution without native platform plugins
avoid_when: You need complex keyboard animation event handling or custom insets manipulation
You are not using Scaffolds that fit the wrapper widget pattern
strengths: Simple API with KeyboardService and KeyboardAutoDismiss widget
Cross-platform support across all Flutter platforms
weaknesses: Limited to basic visibility checks and dismissal
Relies on wrapping Scaffolds for auto-dismissal functionality
